titles.title: I Became a Transcendent-Class Hunter With 100,000x Experience

description:
Just before the world fell to the invading Demon Race, Tenshin Tsukishiro was sent back in time by a mysterious artifact. Once an untalented F Rank Hunter doomed to watch humanity’s destruction, he returns to the past with a unique trait he never possessed in his previous life. [Talent Adjustment: Experience Gain x100,000] One swing of a sword unlocks the Swordsmanship skill and instantly raises it to MAX Level. Read a single book, and he acquires the Intelligence skill, which also reaches MAX Level in no time. In his previous life, he was powerless to stop the world’s end. This time, armed with an extraordinary ability, Tenshin vows to grow stronger than anyone and change fate itself before the apocalypse begins.
Source: MU
